subject: general
question:
Evaluate the following.

75 - 50 ÷ 5 of 2 + 36 ÷ 6 of 4 × 2 (18 - 5 of 2)
solution:
Concept Used:

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3adde1c413c1f7c568b788c2dc968de1e9dc35aa1fc1db53969105a5b0bd016.png] 

**Calculation:**

75 - 50 ÷ 5 of 2 + 36 ÷ 6 of 4 × 2 (18 - 5 of 2)

⇒ 75 - 5 + 3/2 × 2 (18 - 5 of 2)

⇒ 70 + 3(8)

⇒ 70 + 24 

⇒ 94

**∴ The correct answer is 94.**
